_note: Post Studio defaults. The real settings live in desk/data/posts/targets.json (made from this file on first use, never committed). Limits were read on 2026-11-15; platforms change them, so edit them here when they do.

voice.ja: First person, plain and honest, like someone sharing what they tried. Short sentences. No hype words. Say what went well and, when the memo says so, what did not.
voice.en: First person, friendly and plain. Short sentences. No hype. Say what happened and what was learned.
voice.ru: First person, friendly and plain. Short sentences. No hype. Natural Russian written by the person, not a translation.

targets.name: Instagram post (Russian)
targets.style: Instagram caption for the Russian-speaking account. First line hooks. 3 to 6 short lines. Hashtags in Russian or English.

targets.name: Instagram post (English)
targets.style: Instagram caption for the English account. First line hooks. 3 to 6 short lines.

targets.name: Instagram story (Russian)
targets.style: One short line written on the picture. No hashtags.

targets.name: Instagram story (English)
targets.style: One short line written on the picture. No hashtags.

targets.name: Threads (Russian)
targets.style: Conversational, like talking to friends. Ends with a light question when it fits. One topic tag at most.

targets.name: Threads (English)
targets.style: Conversational, like talking to friends. Ends with a light question when it fits. One topic tag at most.

targets.name: X
targets.style: One short post. Japanese counts double on X, so about 120 Japanese characters with the tags.

targets.name: Facebook post
targets.style: Personal profile post for friends and family. About 200 to 400 characters, a little more context than Instagram.

targets.name: Facebook story
targets.style: One short line written on the picture. No hashtags.

targets.name: LinkedIn
targets.style: Professional but personal. What was done, one thing learned, who it may help. 600 to 1300 characters. Line breaks between short paragraphs.

targets.name: note article
targets.style: A note article in Markdown: a lead, 2 to 4 sections with ## headings, short paragraphs, the person's own voice. 1500 to 3000 characters. Hashtags at the end.

targets.name: Company site news
targets.style: A short company news item in polite Japanese (desu/masu). Title, then 300 to 800 characters: what happened, when, where. No hashtags. Test format for now.

targets.name: Reddit
targets.style: A Reddit text post: a plain, honest title and a body that shares the experience without selling anything. Check the community's rules before posting.
